name: creative-plugins
description: Agent plugins for the open-source Crafting Apps (images, video, photos, vectors, PDFs, motion graphics, page layout, spreadsheets and CAD), driven headlessly through their official CLIs

plugins.name: photocraft
plugins.description: Edit images headlessly with PhotoCraft, an open-source Photoshop-style editor: crop, adjustments, filters, layers, masks, compositing and PSD export. Installs the official photocraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: filmcraft
plugins.description: Edit video headlessly with FilmCraft, an open-source Premiere-style editor: import media, build sequences, cut, apply effects, render frames and export. Installs the official filmcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: lightcraft
plugins.description: Develop and export photos headlessly with LightCraft, an open-source Lightroom-style raw developer: exposure, colour, presets, auto settings, HDR/panorama merge and batch export. Installs the official lightcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: vectorcraft
plugins.description: Create and edit vector artwork headlessly with VectorCraft, an open-source Illustrator-style editor: shapes, paths, text, gradients, live effects, Pathfinder, artboards, image trace and conversion between SVG, PDF, AI, EPS, DXF and PNG/JPEG. Installs the official vectorcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: pdfcraft
plugins.description: Work on PDFs headlessly with PdfCraft, an open-source Acrobat-style editor: merge, split, reorder and rotate pages, extract text and images, render pages, fill forms, passwords, redaction, watermarks, OCR and Word/HTML export. Installs the official pdfcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: effectcraft
plugins.description: Create motion graphics headlessly with EffectCraft, an open-source After Effects-style compositor: compositions, text, shape, solid and footage layers, keyframes, expressions, effects, masks and scripting, rendered to H.264, ProRes, WebM, GIF, image sequences or Lottie. Installs the official effectcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: designcraft
plugins.description: Lay out pages headlessly with DesignCraft, an open-source InDesign-style publishing app: documents and pages, text and graphic frames, threaded stories, styles, parent pages, tables, TOC, data merge, packaging and export to PDF, PNG, IDML and EPUB. Installs the official designcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: gridcraft
plugins.description: Build and analyse spreadsheets headlessly with GridCraft, an open-source Excel-style spreadsheet app: cells and formulas, formatting, sort and filter, tables, charts, pivot tables and conversion between XLSX, CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML and PDF. Installs the official gridcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.

plugins.name: cadcraft
plugins.description: Draft 2D CAD drawings headlessly with CADCraft, an open-source AutoCAD-style drafting app: lines, polylines, circles, text, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks, arrays and edits by handle, with DXF/DWG open and save and SVG, PNG and PDF export. Installs the official cadcraft-cli into the plugin's bin/.
